report: A 59-year-old woman shows 2-year progressive spoken-language comprehension loss with anomia, phonemic paraphasia, and severe comprehension/repetition impairment but preserved writing. Mild hearing loss with ineffective aids makes hearing and vascular causes unlikely. FDG-PET temporoparietal hypometabolism (left-predominant), left temporal atrophy, and diffuse cortical amyloid indicate Alzheimer pathology, and the radiologist agrees, confirming logopenic variant PPA due to Alzheimer disease.
